say.9.2061: nine point two oh six one
say.148341: one hundred forty-eight thousand, three hundred forty-one

scenes.name: NINETEEN POINTS
lines: Nineteen integer points lie on the sphere x squared plus y squared plus z squared equals 867.
球面 x² + y² + z² = 867 上恰有十九个整点。
Join nearby points by 135 edges, and give every edge a phase that depends on the charge.
把相近的点连成 135 条边，每条边带一个随荷而变的相位。
Five hypercharges give five spectra, and in every one, exactly three modes sit low.
五种超荷给出五套谱，每一套里都恰有三个模落在低端。
Are three low notes the same thing as three generations of matter?
三声低音，就等于三代物质吗？

scenes.name: ONE GAP, WHOLE TORUS
lines: Here are all nineteen eigenvalues, one column for each charge: one, two, minus three, minus four, six.
这是全部十九个本征值，每种荷一列：1、2、−3、−4、6。
Now let the two clocks turn, shifting the phases on two families of edges, all over the torus.
现在让两只钟转起来：它们改写两族边上的相位，扫遍整张环面。
Three cyan modes stay below 8.685, and sixteen stay above 9.6.
三个青色模始终低于 8.685，其余十六个始终高于 9.6。
An interval certificate extends this to the entire torus and every positive Riemann zero.
区间证书把这一点推广到整张环面与全部正黎曼零点。

scenes.name: TURN THE COORDINATES
lines: Why are the three light modes never alike? Cycle the coordinates: x to y, y to z, z to x.
为什么三个轻模从不雷同？把坐标轮换：x 变 y，y 变 z，z 变 x。
The shell lands on itself, so every matrix splits into blocks of seven, six and six.
球壳映回自身，于是每个矩阵都拆成七、六、六三块。
Each block holds exactly one light mode: one for each character, one, omega, omega squared.
每块恰好分到一个轻模：循环特征标 1、ω、ω² 各占一个。
Behind such splits, Lean checks a rational fact: even Chebyshev characters are orthonormal under a Haar average built without pi.
Lean 内核检验：无 π 哈尔平均下，偶次切比雪夫特征标正交归一。

scenes.name: WHERE TO CUT
lines: But three is not forced. Gaps shared by all zeros allow one, three, seven or fifteen light modes.
但三并非必然。全部零点共享的谱隙，容许 1、3、7 或 15 个轻模。
The widest gap picks one; equal characters rule out one and seven, but leave three and fifteen.
最宽谱隙选出 1；要求特征标等重排除了 1 与 7，却同时留下 3 与 15。
One cut reads only the edge weights: the smallest site variance, T equals nine plus one minus delta, squared.
有一种分界只读边权：最小站点方差 T = 9 + (1 − δ)²。
Three outer sites of degree ten, each on one softened spoke, attain it, so T sits just below ten.
三个度为 10、各连一条软化辐边的外点同时取到它，所以 T 略小于 10。

scenes.name: THREE ZEROS
lines: Now read the two-step masses at actual Riemann zeros, against the fixed cut nine and the cut T.
现在在实际黎曼零点上读两步质量，对照固定分界 9 与分界 T。
At zero number 8236, the third mass is 9.2061: above nine, below T.
第 8236 号零点的第三个质量是 9.2061：高于 9，低于 T。
Under T it becomes the earliest zero to hit all three windows, and T rescues zero number 148341 as well.
按 T 分界，它成为最早三窗齐中的零点；第 148341 号零点也被 T 挽救。
Still, T is a model choice: with charge-conjugate pairs on each site, zero 8359 keeps only two charge-two modes.
但 T 仍是模型假设：每个站点放入电荷共轭双态后，第 8359 号零点的荷二只剩两个轻模。

scenes.name: INTO FOUR DIMENSIONS
lines: Three positive eigenvalues are not yet four-dimensional Weyl fermions.
三个正本征值，还不是四维外尔费米子。
On a four-dimensional lattice, a five-step overlap kernel with Wilson mass in a narrow window gives three species of one chirality.
在四维格点上，威尔逊质量落在一个窄窗内的五步重叠核，给出三个同手征物种。
With the shell itself as the mass term, the index on gently curved fields is three times a single one; the sixteen heavy layers give zero.
把球壳本身当作质量项，小曲率规范场上的指数恰为单份的三倍，十六个重层贡献为零。

scenes.name: ROUGH FIELDS
lines: But the path integral is dominated by rough gauge links.
可路径积分的主体，是粗糙的规范链。
One explicit SU five background gives indices two and seven: centre charge twelve, two mod five, not zero.
一个显式 SU(5) 粗糙背景给出指数 (2, 7)：中心荷 12，模 5 余 2，不为零。
Three orthogonal Higgs frames leave an SU two and lose the gap; four frames hold it.
三份正交希格斯标架留下 SU(2)，守不住谱隙；四份才守得住。
Still open: why three and not fifteen, why this cut, and a chiral measure without frames put in by hand.
仍然开放：为何是 3 而不是 15，为何是这条分界，以及不靠外置标架的手征测度。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Omega Unification, chapter seven.
《OMEGA 统一》· 第七章
